rooms.name: St. Andral's Church
rooms.desc: A slouching stone church with a bulging steeple, stained glass of saints cracked in every window, an iron-fenced garden of graves beside it.
rooms.dm: Father Lucian, Yeska and Milivoj. The bones of St. Andral are gone from the crypt: Milivoj took them to the coffin maker. Same plan as the village church, no undercroft.

rooms.name: Blue Water Inn
rooms.desc: A two-storey inn on the main street with a well in its yard and an outside stair.
rooms.dm: The Martikovs' inn: Urwin and Danika, the boys, Rictavio's wagon in the stable yard. Open the map for the floors.

rooms.name: Wachterhaus
rooms.desc: A grand old house of three storeys with its own small grounds.
rooms.dm: Lady Fiona Wachter, her sons and daughter, the cult meeting in the cellar.

rooms.name: Blinsky Toys
rooms.desc: A toymaker's shop with a cheerful, slightly wrong sign.
rooms.dm: Gadof Blinsky and his toys; the doll that looks like Ireena.

rooms.name: Town Square
rooms.desc: The town square: the stocks, the festival stage, a dry well.
rooms.dm: Festival of the Blazing Sun; Izek's guards; the stocks for malcontents.

rooms.name: Burgomaster's Mansion
rooms.desc: The burgomaster's mansion behind its gate, banners of the festival on the posts.
rooms.dm: Baron Vargas, Lydia, Victor in the attic, Izek. The cells in the basement hold the town's complainers.

rooms.name: Coffin Maker's Shop
rooms.desc: A narrow two-storey shop with coffins stacked in its window.
rooms.dm: Henrik van der Voort; the stolen bones and six vampire spawn in the nest above.

rooms.name: Arasek Stockyard
rooms.desc: Pens and a warehouse by the east gate where the stockyard's beasts are kept.
rooms.dm: Ernst Larnak's territory; Rictavio's tiger is penned here.

rooms.name: Vistani Camp
rooms.desc: A Vistani camp in a hollow outside the west wall: wagons, horses, fires.
rooms.dm: Luvash and Arrigal; Arabelle missing; Kasimir's hovel among the dusk elves.
